A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Adaptive-k research work. Their complete text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendix A are readable and support reliable matching across the revisions.

before.justification: v1 reports original retrieval, answer-quality, and token-use results on factoid and aggregation QA, including Figures 3-5 and the detailed results in Appendix A.3.

after.justification: v2 retains those experiments and adds Contriever retrieval results in Table 3 and retrieval-cutoff error measurements in Tables 4-5.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same largest-similarity-gap procedure, five-document buffer, and restriction to the top 90% of ranked documents. Contriever is an additional evaluation configuration; the proposed retrieval procedure is unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate HELMET's HotpotQA, Natural Questions, and TriviaQA, plus HoloBench with 5k, 10k, 25k, and 50k relevant tokens. The new cutoff analysis reuses HotpotQA and the existing HoloBench-50k scenario.

E2.justification: The evaluated comparison methods remain zero-shot, full-context, SELF-ROUTE, and the same fixed-token retrieval variants. Table 3 still compares Adaptive-k with SELF-ROUTE, now under an additional shared embedding configuration; Tables 4-5 use existing retrieval methods.

E3.justification: v2 adds the 109M-parameter Contriever embedding configuration and evaluates a new cutoff-error metric, diff-k, in Tables 4-5. Existing sample sizes, context lengths, retrieval budgets, generation metrics, and Appendix A.2 decoding settings are unchanged.

E4.justification: Table 3 extends the embedding-sensitivity analysis to Contriever. Section 5.5 adds a diagnostic comparing estimated retrieval cutoffs with the cutoff required for full recall on HotpotQA and HoloBench-50k, a question not directly measured in v1.

E5.justification: Appendix A.3 retains exactly the same plus/minus summaries. v2 adds no seed counts, repeated-run information, confidence intervals, significance tests, or uncertainty estimates for the new tables.

E6.justification: v2 adds Contriever recall values, including HotpotQA scores of 49.17 for Adaptive-k and 77.50 for SELF-ROUTE. Tables 4-5 newly report cutoff errors; for BGE on HoloBench-50k these are 1248.99 and 2186.09, respectively. Existing results, including all Appendix A.3 values, are unchanged.

T1.justification: Section 5.5 introduces a mathematical reference cutoff defined by the last relevant chunk in similarity order, and diff-k as average absolute cutoff error. The following sentence confusingly calls the full-recall cutoff diff-k. Existing algorithmic reasoning and complexity analysis are unchanged, with no new proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about single-pass, tuning-free adaptive retrieval, token savings, and performance across factoid and aggregation QA. The additions provide supporting evidence without redefining these core contributions.

C2.justification: Section 5.5 newly interprets proximity to selected fixed-budget oracle errors as evidence of reliable cutoff selection. Table 5 also qualifies GTE's cutoff results as uninformative because of poor factoid retrieval. Existing mechanism explanations and limitations are retained.

D1.justification: v2 adds a code-availability statement and repository address on page 1, a Contriever model link, and embedding parameter counts in Section 4.2. Existing prompt templates, reader identifiers, and decoding settings in Appendix A are unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds Izacard et al. (2021), Unsupervised Dense Information Retrieval with Contrastive Learning, as the Contriever reference. Section 2 and Table 1 retain the existing research positioning and comparisons with prior approaches.

P1.justification: Changes are localized to the embedding-model description, embedding discussion, added cutoff-analysis paragraphs, acknowledgments, and footnotes. The internship note is removed. The overall section structure and most wording remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 3 gains a Contriever column, and two small cutoff-error tables are added as Tables 4-5. Subsequent text reflows and appendix tables are renumbered. Existing figures and appendix table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: The additional embedding results and cutoff diagnostic modestly strengthen empirical scrutiny of the retrieval heuristic, while the repository address improves reproducibility information. These benefits are limited by the inconsistent diff-k definition in Section 5.5 and the abstract's unchanged reference to only two embedding models. The underlying method and existing experimental evidence remain intact.
